description: Empty permission set. The frontend imports `invoke` from @tauri-apps/api/core but uses ZERO Tauri core APIs (no window, event, path, app, image, menu, tray, webview, resources). The only IPC is the custom `copy_xml_to_clipboard` command, which is granted via the `invoke_handler!` macro in src/lib.rs and bypasses the ACL system. Granting `core:default` would expose 9 plugin permission sets the app never touches.
